name: The Ricer
description: Aether and the must-have apps for shaping the desktop, inspecting colors, and editing visuals.

items.name: aether
items.summary: GTK app that extracts a palette from a wallpaper and themes the desktop.

items.name: gpick
items.summary: GTK color picker for sampling colors and building palettes.

items.name: pastel
items.summary: Command-line tool to generate, analyze, and convert colors.

items.name: imv
items.summary: Keyboard-driven image viewer for Wayland and X11.

items.name: satty
items.summary: Wayland screenshot annotation with arrows, text, blur, and crop.

items.name: nwg-look
items.summary: GTK settings editor for wlroots: theme, icons, cursor, and fonts.

items.name: qt6ct
items.summary: Configuration utility for the appearance of Qt 6 applications.

items.name: qt5ct
items.summary: Configuration utility for the appearance of Qt 5 applications.

items.name: kvantum
items.summary: SVG theme engine and manager for Qt applications.

items.name: papirus-icon-theme
items.summary: SVG icon theme with light and dark variants and folder colors.

items.name: font-manager
items.summary: GTK app to preview, compare, and manage installed fonts.

items.name: cpufetch
items.summary: Terminal CPU information with ASCII architecture art.

items.name: cbonsai
items.summary: ncurses bonsai tree generator and screensaver.
